Power to the Bench

Back to quest database

Quick answer

A five-objective utility tutorial that connects City Hall, Victor's contract and the ranch workbench.

Recorded build reference · 0.8.10.842 · configuration record, not individually play-tested

Objectives and actionable steps

  1. Have 1,000 C available before starting the contract route.
  2. Visit City Hall; the configured check also accepts an existing electricity contract.
  3. Arrange the electricity contract with Victor.
  4. Build a workbench at the ranch, not just its blueprint.
  5. Open the phone's energy meter app to check usage.

Checks that can cause a stop

  • The last objective checks whether the energy app is open; building the workbench alone does not satisfy that step.

Failure, recovery and continuation

Failure trigger
No quest-level failure trigger recorded
How to recover after failure
Restarts the current quest
After success
Starts a configured follow-up call
